name: Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse
desc:
The Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse is a lighthouse with a passage underneath for boats to spawn in.

It can be found past a gate beside [Starfield Veldt](location:starfield_veldt), and near the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils), after sailing past 2 closed gates, near the [Voidsea](location:voidsea).
